title: SEO

quiz.question: Which removes a page from the index?
options: A noindex meta tag or X-Robots-Tag header on a crawlable page
Deleting it from the sitemap only
quiz.explanation: Disallow blocks crawling, so Google cannot see a noindex.

quiz.question: Which rendering approach is safest for SEO?
quiz.explanation: HTML content is available without executing JavaScript.

quiz.question: Which Core Web Vital measures responsiveness and replaced FID?
quiz.explanation: Interaction to Next Paint; good is ≤ 200 ms.

quiz.question: Two near-identical pages target "best biryani dhaka" and "top biryani dhaka". The problem?
quiz.explanation: Consolidate into one strong page per intent.

quiz.question: Which permanent redirect consolidates ranking signals?
What is the most important element of E-E-A-T?
quiz.explanation: Trust is central; the others support it.

quiz.question: What does NAP mean in local SEO?
quiz.explanation: Consistency across listings supports local rankings.

problems.title: Rescue organic traffic after an SPA rebuild
problems.prompt: Organic traffic fell 60% after moving to a client-rendered SPA. Plan the fix.
problems.solution: Diagnose with URL Inspection/rendered HTML; move public pages to SSR/SSG (e.g., Next.js); unique titles, descriptions, canonicals; real <a href> links; proper 404s; sitemap; structured data; monitor coverage and traffic by page type.
